213:     pub fn insert(&mut self, from: &str, to: MappingTarget<'a>) -> Result<()> {
214:         let extra_slots = {

216:             let highlighted_lines = &self.context.highlighted_lines.0;
217:             let visible_lines = match self.context.visible_lines.line_ranges() {
218:                 Some(ranges) => ranges,
219:                 None => highlighted_lines,
220:             };
221: 
222:             let mut extra_slots = decorations.len() + self.context.tab_width.min(2);
223:             extra_slots += visible_lines.all_ranges().len();
224:             extra_slots += visible_lines.max_line().min(1);
225:             for range in visible_lines.all_ranges() {
226:                 extra_slots += usize::from(range.lower() <= range.upper());
227:             }
228:             extra_slots += highlighted_lines.all_ranges().len();
229:             extra_slots += highlighted_lines.max_line().min(1);
230:             for range in highlighted_lines.all_ranges() {
231:                 extra_slots += usize::from(range.lower() <= range.upper());
232:             }
233:             extra_slots
234:         };
235:         self.context.mappings.reserve(extra_slots.max(1));

249:     pub(crate) fn get_syntax_for(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<MappingTarget<'a>> {
250:         // Try matching on the file name as-is.
251:         let candidate = Candidate::new(&path);
252:         let candidate_filename = path.as_ref().file_name().map(Candidate::new);
253:         for (ref glob, ref syntax) in self.context.mappings.iter().rev() {
254:             if glob.is_match_candidate(&candidate)
255:                 || candidate_filename
256:                     .as_ref()
257:                     .map_or(false, |filename| glob.is_match_candidate(filename))
258:             {
259:                 return Some(*syntax);
260:             }
261:         }
262:         // Try matching on the file name after removing an ignored suffix.
263:         let file_name = path.as_ref().file_name()?;
264:         self.ignored_suffixes
265:             .try_with_stripped_suffix(file_name, |stripped_file_name| {
266:                 Ok(self.get_syntax_for(stripped_file_name))
267:             })
268:             .ok()?
269:     }

// Regression test for issue #2520 and PR #2650
// Syntax highlighting should be the same regardless of
// --map-syntax' case or file extension's case
#[test]
fn highlighting_independant_from_map_syntax_case() {
    let expected = bat()
        .arg("-f")
        .arg("--map-syntax=*.config:JSON")
        .arg("map-syntax_case.Config")
        .assert()
        .get_output()
        .stdout
        .clone();

    bat()
        .arg("-f")
        .arg("--map-syntax=*.Config:JSON")
        .arg("map-syntax_case.Config")
        .assert()
        .success()
        .stdout(expected)
        .stderr("");
}
